notes.note: Bounded bf0ad914 shutdown re-entry review: publish one shared pause promise before invoking synchronous job/lease AbortSignal callbacks, then settle that promise from the existing cleanup operation. This preserves synchronous abort delivery while re-entrant pause joins exactly the same result instead of running competing finally blocks. Real-owner regression uses an actual lease abort listener and final-worker identity ENOENT: the same promise retains original error, closes SQLite once, retires liveness, and permits committed-turn recovery without stale pause removing the replacement. Reverting only early promise publication reproduces masked TypeError; exact source restoration passes. Reviewed the document's owner/adoption/recovery passages; no prose change needed. This note extends only the previous final-checkpoint cleanup delta; dispatch/authorization/schema/approvals/FULL commits and physical/provider/release limits are unchanged.
